dedupe_keys.name: large eddy simulation de la combustion riche en ammoniac hydrogene air dans un bruleur a turbine a gaz

description: Large Eddy Simulation de la combustion riche en ammoniac/hydrogène/air dans un brûleur à turbine à gaz is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Université catholique de Louvain. Paper on - Combustion characteristics of NH3/H2 blends were explored from 1D simulations. - NOX/NH3 emissions trade-off is found for a precise equivalence ratio in rich blends. - The equivalence ratio at emissions trade-off increases with hydrogen addition. - 3D LES yields NOX/NH3 emissions of ~300 ppmv for f ¼ 1:46 and XFuel H2¼ 0:46. Coverage: Université catholique de Louvain. The portal shows the English title as "Large Eddy Simulation of rich ammonia/hydrogen/ air combustion in a gas turbine burner" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Université catholique de Louvain. Its keywords include Electrofuels, Large Eddy Simulation, Gas turbine, Pollutant emissions, Kinetic mechanism reduction. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2022-08-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
